note: *Ich rufe dich morgen an.* = I'll call you tomorrow.
*Du siehst müde aus.* = You look tired.
Also *to treat*: *Ich lade dich ein.* = It's on me.
For trains, buses and people setting off: *Der Zug fährt um acht ab.*
Reflexive for getting dressed: *Ich ziehe mich an.*

english: to get to know, to meet
note: *Wir haben uns in Rom kennengelernt.* = We met in Rome.
Takes the dative: *Hör mir zu!* = Listen to me!

english: to get on (a bus, a train)
to get off (a bus, a train)
